text: There is one God.
greek: εἰς ἕνα Θεόν

text: The Father is almighty, Maker of heaven and earth, of all things visible and invisible; the material world is the work of the one true God.
greek: Πατέρα παντοκράτορα, ποιητὴν οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς

text: Father, Son and Holy Spirit are truly distinct: the Son is begotten of the Father, and the Spirit is worshipped together with the Father and the Son. They are not three names or modes of a single person.
greek: ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς γεννηθέντα; σὺν Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ

text: Jesus Christ is the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all ages: there was no time when the Son was not.
greek: τὸν μονογενῆ, τὸν ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς γεννηθέντα πρὸ πάντων τῶν αἰώνων

text: The Son is begotten, not made: he is not a creature.
greek: γεννηθέντα, οὐ ποιηθέντα

text: The Son is true God from true God, Light from Light.
greek: φῶς ἐκ φωτός, Θεὸν ἀληθινὸν ἐκ Θεοῦ ἀληθινοῦ

text: The Son is of one substance (homoousios) with the Father: equal in being, not a lesser or similar divinity.
greek: ὁμοούσιον τῷ Πατρί

text: All things were made through the Son.
greek: δι᾿ οὗ τὰ πάντα ἐγένετο

text: For us and for our salvation the Son came down from heaven and was incarnate.
greek: δι᾿ ἡμᾶς ... καὶ διὰ τὴν ἡμετέραν σωτηρίαν κατελθόντα ... σαρκωθέντα

text: He was incarnate by the Holy Spirit of the Virgin Mary.
greek: σαρκωθέντα ἐκ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ Μαρίας τῆς Παρθένου

text: He became truly and fully human, not only in appearance and not lacking a human mind or soul.
greek: ἐνανθρωπήσαντα

text: He was crucified for us under Pontius Pilate, truly suffered and died, and was buried.
greek: σταυρωθέντα τε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου, καὶ παθόντα καὶ ταφέντα

text: On the third day he rose again according to the Scriptures: a real, bodily resurrection, not only a metaphor or a vision.
greek: ἀναστάντα τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ κατὰ τὰς Γραφάς

text: He ascended into heaven and is seated at the right hand of the Father.
greek: ἀνελθόντα εἰς τοὺς οὐρανούς, καὶ καθεζόμενον ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Πατρός

text: He will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead.
greek: πάλιν ἐρχόμενον μετὰ δόξης κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς

text: His kingdom will have no end.
greek: οὗ τῆς βασιλείας οὐκ ἔσται τέλος

text: The Holy Spirit is Lord and Giver of life, not an impersonal force or a creature.
greek: τὸ κύριον, τὸ ζωοποιόν

text: The Holy Spirit proceeds from the Father. (Western churches add 'and the Son'; Dust treats both forms, and 'through the Son', as inside the boundary.)
greek: τὸ ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐκπορευόμενον

text: The Holy Spirit, with the Father and the Son, is worshipped and glorified: the Spirit is fully divine.
greek: τὸ σὺν Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ συμπροσκυνούμενον καὶ συνδοξαζόμενον

text: The Holy Spirit spoke through the prophets.
greek: τὸ λαλῆσαν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν

text: There is one holy, catholic and apostolic Church.
greek: Εἰς μίαν, ἁγίαν, καθολικὴν καὶ ἀποστολικὴν Ἐκκλησίαν
note: Traditions identify the one Church differently. Only outright denial that Christ has a Church is treated as outside; which body is the Church is a latitude question (L05).

text: There is one baptism for the forgiveness of sins.
greek: ἓν βάπτισμα εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
note: Subjects, mode and sacramental meaning differ across traditions (L03). Rebaptism disputes are not checked.

text: We look for the resurrection of the dead.
greek: Προσδοκῶμεν ἀνάστασιν νεκρῶν

text: We look for the life of the world to come.
greek: ζωὴν τοῦ μέλλοντος αἰῶνος
